passages.text: You must carefully follow every commandment I am giving you today, so that you may live and multiply, and enter and possess the land that the LORD swore to give your fathers.
passages.sermon:
Moses spoke to the Israelites.
He gave them commandments from the LORD.
He told them to obey every commandment he gave that day.
They must keep and do all these commandments.
If they obey, they will live.
If they obey, they will multiply.
If they obey, they will enter the land.
If they obey, they will possess the land.
The LORD swore to give this land to their fathers.
passages.original: כָּל־ הַמִּצְוָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר אָנֹכִ֧י מְצַוְּךָ֛ הַיּ֖וֹם תִּשְׁמְר֣וּן לַעֲשׂ֑וֹת לְמַ֨עַן תִּֽחְי֜וּן וּרְבִיתֶ֗ם וּבָאתֶם֙ וִֽירִשְׁתֶּ֣ם אֶת־ הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־ נִשְׁבַּ֥ע יְהוָ֖ה לַאֲבֹתֵיכֶֽם׃

passages.text: Remember that these forty years the LORD your God led you all the way in the wilderness, so that He might humble you and test you in order to know what was in your heart, whether or not you would keep His commandments.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is your God.
The LORD led you in the wilderness for forty years.
He led you all the way.
Remember this.
He did this to humble you.
He did this to test you.
He wanted to know what was in your heart.
He wanted to see if you would keep His commandments.
He wanted to see if you would obey Him or not.
passages.original: וְזָכַרְתָּ֣ אֶת־ כָּל־ הַדֶּ֗רֶךְ אֲשֶׁ֨ר הֹלִֽיכֲךָ֜ יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֶ֛יךָ זֶ֛ה אַרְבָּעִ֥ים שָׁנָ֖ה בַּמִּדְבָּ֑ר לְמַ֨עַן עַנֹּֽתְךָ֜ לְנַסֹּֽתְךָ֗ לָדַ֜עַת אֶת־ אֲשֶׁ֧ר בִּֽלְבָבְךָ֛ הֲתִשְׁמֹ֥ר מִצְוֹתוֹ אִם־ לֹֽא׃

passages.text: He humbled you, and in your hunger He gave you manna to eat, which neither you nor your fathers had known, so that you might understand that man does not live on bread alone, but on every word that comes from the mouth of the LORD.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is your God.
The LORD humbled you.
You became hungry.
The LORD gave you manna to eat.
You did not know manna before.
Your fathers did not know manna before.
The LORD did this to teach you something.
Man does not live by bread alone.
Man lives by every word that comes from the mouth of the LORD.
passages.original: וַֽיְעַנְּךָ֮ וַיַּרְעִבֶךָ֒ וַיַּֽאֲכִֽלְךָ֤ אֶת הַמָּן֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹא־ יָדַ֔עְתָּ וְלֹ֥א יָדְע֖וּן אֲבֹתֶ֑יךָ לְמַ֣עַן הוֹדִֽעֲךָ֗ כִּ֠י לֹ֣א עַל־ הַלֶּ֤חֶם לְבַדּוֹ֙ יִחְיֶ֣ה הָֽאָדָ֔ם כִּ֛י עַל־ כָּל־ מוֹצָ֥א פִֽי־ יְהוָ֖ה יִחְיֶ֥ה הָאָדָֽם׃

passages.text: Your clothing did not wear out and your feet did not swell during these forty years.
passages.sermon:
God led the Israelites in the wilderness for forty years.
During these forty years, God cared for them.
Their clothing did not wear out.
Their feet did not swell.
passages.original: שִׂמְלָ֨תְךָ֜ לֹ֤א בָֽלְתָה֙ מֵֽעָלֶ֔יךָ וְרַגְלְךָ֖ לֹ֣א בָצֵ֑קָה זֶ֖ה אַרְבָּעִ֥ים שָׁנָֽה׃

passages.text: So know in your heart that just as a man disciplines his son, so the LORD your God disciplines you.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is your God.
A man disciplines his son.
The LORD your God disciplines you in the same way.
Know this in your heart.
passages.original: וְיָדַעְתָּ֖ עִם־ לְבָבֶ֑ךָ כִּ֗י כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר יְיַסֵּ֥ר אִישׁ֙ אֶת־ בְּנ֔וֹ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ מְיַסְּרֶֽךָּ׃

passages.text: Therefore you shall keep the commandments of the LORD your God, walking in His ways and fearing Him.
passages.sermon: You must keep the commandments of the LORD your God.\r\nYou must walk in His ways.\r\nYou must fear Him.
passages.original: וְשָׁ֣מַרְתָּ֔ אֶת־ מִצְוֺ֖ת יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ לָלֶ֥כֶת בִּדְרָכָ֖יו וּלְיִרְאָ֥ה אֹתֽוֹ׃

passages.text: For the LORD your God is bringing you into a good land, a land of brooks and fountains and springs that flow through the valleys and hills; a land of wheat, barley, vines, fig trees, and pomegranates; a land of olive oil and honey; a land where you will eat food without scarcity, where you will lack nothing; a land whose rocks are iron and whose hills are ready to be mined for copper.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is your God.
The LORD is bringing you into a good land.
This land has brooks of water.
This land has fountains and springs.
The water flows in the valleys and in the hills.
This land grows wheat and barley.
This land has vines, fig trees, and pomegranates.
This land has olive oil and honey.
You will eat bread in this land without scarcity.
You will not lack anything in this land.
The rocks in this land are iron.
You can mine copper from the hills in this land.
passages.original: כִּ֚י יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ מְבִֽיאֲךָ֖ אֶל־ אֶ֣רֶץ טוֹבָ֑ה אֶ֚רֶץ נַ֣חֲלֵי מָ֔יִם עֲיָנֹת֙ וּתְהֹמֹ֔ת יֹצְאִ֥ים בַּבִּקְעָ֖ה וּבָהָֽר׃ אֶ֤רֶץ חִטָּה֙ וּשְׂעֹרָ֔ה וְגֶ֥פֶן וּתְאֵנָ֖ה וְרִמּ֑וֹן אֶֽרֶץ־ זֵ֥ית שֶׁ֖מֶן וּדְבָֽשׁ׃ אֶ֗רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֨ר לֹ֤א בְמִסְכֵּנֻת֙ תֹּֽאכַל־ בָּ֣הּ לֶ֔חֶם לֹֽא־ תֶחְסַ֥ר כֹּ֖ל בָּ֑הּ אֶ֚רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אֲבָנֶ֣יהָ בַרְזֶ֔ל וּמֵהֲרָרֶ֖יהָ תַּחְצֹ֥ב נְחֹֽשֶׁת׃

passages.text: When you eat and are satisfied, you are to bless the LORD your God for the good land that He has given you.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is your God.
He has given you a good land.
You will eat in this land.
You will be satisfied.
You must bless the LORD your God.
You must thank Him for the good land He has given you.
passages.original: וְאָכַלְתָּ֖ וְשָׂבָ֑עְתָּ וּבֵֽרַכְתָּ֙ אֶת־ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ עַל־ הָאָ֥רֶץ הַטֹּבָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָֽתַן־ לָֽךְ׃

passages.text: Be careful not to forget the LORD your God by failing to keep His commandments and ordinances and statutes, which I am giving you this day.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is your God.
He gives you commandments, ordinances, and statutes today.
Be careful.
Do not forget the LORD your God.
Do not fail to keep His commandments.
Do not fail to keep His ordinances.
Do not fail to keep His statutes.
passages.original: הִשָּׁ֣מֶר לְךָ֔ פֶּן־ תִּשְׁכַּ֖ח אֶת־ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ לְבִלְתִּ֨י שְׁמֹ֤ר מִצְוֺתָיו֙ וּמִשְׁפָּטָ֣יו וְחֻקֹּתָ֔יו אֲשֶׁ֛ר אָנֹכִ֥י מְצַוְּךָ֖ הַיּֽוֹם׃

passages.text: Otherwise, when you eat and are satisfied, when you build fine houses in which to dwell, and when your herds and flocks grow large and your silver and gold increase and all that you have is multiplied, then your heart will become proud, and you will forget the LORD your God who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of slavery.
passages.sermon:
God is the LORD your God.
God brought you out of the land of Egypt.
Egypt was the house of slavery.
You may eat and be satisfied.
You may build good houses.
You may live in those houses.
Your herds may become many.
Your flocks may become many.
Your silver may increase.
Your gold may increase.
Everything you have may become great.
Then your heart may become proud.
You may forget the LORD your God.
passages.original: פֶּן־ תֹּאכַ֖ל וְשָׂבָ֑עְתָּ וּבָתִּ֥ים טוֹבִ֛ים תִּבְנֶ֖ה וְיָשָֽׁבְתָּ׃ וּבְקָֽרְךָ֤ וְצֹֽאנְךָ֙ יִרְבְּיֻ֔ן וְכֶ֥סֶף וְזָהָ֖ב יִרְבֶּה־ לָּ֑ךְ וְכֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־ לְךָ֖ יִרְבֶּֽה׃ וְרָ֖ם לְבָבֶ֑ךָ וְשָֽׁכַחְתָּ֙ אֶת־ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ הַמּוֹצִיאֲךָ֛ מֵאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרַ֖יִם מִבֵּ֥ית עֲבָדִֽים׃

passages.text: He led you through the vast and terrifying wilderness with its venomous snakes and scorpions, a thirsty and waterless land. He brought you water from the rock of flint.
passages.sermon:
The LORD your God led you.
He led you through the wilderness.
The wilderness was vast.
The wilderness was terrifying.
There were venomous snakes in the wilderness.
There were scorpions in the wilderness.
The land was dry and thirsty.
There was no water in the land.
The LORD your God brought you water.
He brought you water from a rock of flint.
passages.original: הַמּוֹלִ֨יכֲךָ֜ בַּמִּדְבָּ֣ר׀ הַגָּדֹ֣ל וְהַנּוֹרָ֗א נָחָ֤שׁ׀ שָׂרָף֙ וְעַקְרָ֔ב וְצִמָּא֖וֹן אֲשֶׁ֣ר אֵֽין־ מָ֑יִם הַמּוֹצִ֤יא לְךָ֙ מַ֔יִם מִצּ֖וּר הַֽחַלָּמִֽישׁ׃

passages.text: He fed you in the wilderness with manna that your fathers had not known, in order to humble you and test you, so that in the end He might cause you to prosper.
passages.sermon:
God led the Israelites out of Egypt.
God brought them through the wilderness.
God fed the Israelites in the wilderness.
He gave them manna to eat.
Their fathers did not know this manna.
God did this to humble the Israelites.
God did this to test them.
God wanted to do good to them in the end.
passages.original: הַמַּֽאֲכִ֨לְךָ֥ מָן֙ בַּמִּדְבָּ֔ר אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא־ יָדְע֖וּן אֲבֹתֶ֑יךָ לְמַ֣עַן עַנֹּֽתְךָ֗ וּלְמַ֙עַן֙ נַסֹּתֶ֔ךָ לְהֵיטִֽבְךָ֖ בְּאַחֲרִיתֶֽךָ׃

passages.text: You might say in your heart, “The power and strength of my hands have made this wealth for me.”
passages.sermon: You might think this in your heart.\r\nYou might say, “My own power made me strong.”\r\nYou might say, “My own hands gave me this wealth.”
passages.original: וְאָמַרְתָּ֖ בִּלְבָבֶ֑ךָ כֹּחִי֙ וְעֹ֣צֶם יָדִ֔י עָ֥שָׂה לִ֖י אֶת־ הַחַ֥יִל הַזֶּֽה׃

passages.text: But remember that it is the LORD your God who gives you the power to gain wealth, in order to confirm His covenant that He swore to your fathers even to this day.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is your God.
He gives you power.
He gives you power to gain wealth.
Remember the LORD your God.
He does this to keep His covenant.
He swore this covenant to your fathers.
He keeps this promise even today.
passages.original: וְזָֽכַרְתָּ֙ אֶת־ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ כִּ֣י ה֗וּא הַנֹּתֵ֥ן לְךָ֛ כֹּ֖חַ לַעֲשׂ֣וֹת חָ֑יִל לְמַ֨עַן הָקִ֧ים אֶת־ בְּרִית֛וֹ אֲשֶׁר־ נִשְׁבַּ֥ע לַאֲבֹתֶ֖יךָ כַּיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃פ

passages.text: If you ever forget the LORD your God and go after other gods to worship and bow down to them, I testify against you today that you will surely perish.
passages.sermon:
God is the LORD your God.
God commands you to remember Him.
If you forget the LORD your God, you will turn away from Him.
If you follow other gods, you will leave the LORD.
If you serve other gods, you will worship them.
If you bow down to other gods, you reject the LORD.
Today I warn you.
You will surely perish if you do these things.
passages.original: וְהָיָ֗ה אִם־ שָׁכֹ֤חַ תִּשְׁכַּח֙ אֶת־ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ וְהָֽלַכְתָּ֗ אַחֲרֵי֙ אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֔ים וַעֲבַדְתָּ֖ם וְהִשְׁתַּחֲוִ֣יתָ לָהֶ֑ם הַעִדֹ֤תִי בָכֶם֙ הַיּ֔וֹם כִּ֥י אָבֹ֖ד תֹּאבֵדֽוּן׃

passages.text: Like the nations that the LORD has destroyed before you, so you will perish if you do not obey the LORD your God.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is your God.
The LORD destroyed nations before you.
If you do not obey the LORD your God, you will perish.
You will perish just as those nations perished.
passages.original: כַּגּוֹיִ֗ם אֲשֶׁ֤ר יְהוָה֙ מַאֲבִ֣יד מִפְּנֵיכֶ֔ם כֵּ֖ן תֹאבֵד֑וּן עֵ֚קֶב לֹ֣א תִשְׁמְע֔וּן בְּק֖וֹל יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃פ
